quests.instruction: An orange with soft, sunken, moldy patches has gone completely ___. Which word matches?
quests.hint: This word describes fruit spoiled past the point of being edible.
quests.explanation: Wonderful! An orange with soft, sunken, moldy patches has gone completely rotten, matching this word!
quests.funFact: It usually smells very sour or foul when it goes rotten.

quests.instruction: Grapes are sold together, still attached to one stem, in a group called a ___. What's the word?
quests.hint: This word names a cluster of the same fruit, still joined together.
quests.explanation: Terrific! Grapes sold together, still attached to one stem, form a group called a bunch!
quests.funFact: Buying a bunch of bananas is perfect for sharing with a family.

quests.instruction: A single flat piece cut from a ripe mango is called a ___. What's the word?
quests.hint: This word names one flat cut portion, not a wedge or a whole fruit.
quests.explanation: Yes! A single flat piece cut from a ripe mango is called a slice!
quests.funFact: Did you know? slicing a lemon makes perfect circles to put in a glass of water.

quests.instruction: Grapes snipped from the vine just before lunch are still perfectly ___. What's the word?
quests.hint: This word describes fruit at its very best, soon after being picked.
quests.explanation: That's right! Grapes snipped from the vine just before lunch are still perfectly fresh, matching this word!
quests.funFact: Bakeries use fresh fruit to make the most delicious pies.

quests.instruction: Mango slices left in the sun until they become chewy strips have been ___. What's the word?
quests.hint: This word describes fruit made to last much longer on a shelf.
quests.explanation: Great job! Mango slices left in the sun until chewy have been dried, matching this word!
quests.funFact: Drying fruit concentrates the sugar, making it taste even sweeter.

quests.instruction: A hard, pale strawberry with almost no smell is still ___. What's the word?
quests.hint: This word describes fruit picked too soon, before it's fully ready.
quests.explanation: You got it! A hard, pale strawberry with almost no smell is still unripe, matching this word!
quests.funFact: Did you know? unripe fruit is usually hard, sour, and perfectly green.

quests.instruction: Bananas grow and are sold together, curved and joined, in a group called a ___. Which word fits?
quests.hint: This word describes several fruits still connected, hanging together.
quests.explanation: Well done! Bananas grown and sold together, curved and joined, form a group called a bunch!
quests.funFact: You usually pick an entire bunch of grapes at once from the vine.

quests.instruction: A single flat piece cut from a fresh apple is called a ___. What's the word?
quests.hint: This word names a single flat portion, cut with a knife.
quests.explanation: Correct! A single flat piece cut from a fresh apple is called a slice!
quests.funFact: Did you know? a sharp knife is needed to slice cleanly through tough fruit skin.

quests.instruction: A watermelon delivered straight from the farm this week is considered ___. Which word matches?
quests.hint: This word describes fruit that hasn't traveled far or waited long.
quests.explanation: Super! A watermelon delivered straight from the farm this week is considered fresh, matching this word!
quests.funFact: Did you know? fresh fruit has just been picked and has not been frozen or canned.

quests.instruction: A watermelon that sounds hollow when tapped is often a sign it's perfectly ___. What's the word?
quests.hint: This word describes a fruit ready to be cut open and enjoyed.
quests.explanation: Nice work! A watermelon that sounds hollow when tapped is often a sign it's perfectly ripe, matching this word!
quests.funFact: Did you know? ripe fruit is perfectly soft, sweet, and ready to eat immediately.

quests.instruction: One thin piece cut from a fresh pineapple round is called a ___. Which word fits?
quests.hint: This word describes a single flat portion cut from a larger whole.
quests.explanation: You found it! One thin piece cut from a fresh pineapple round is called a slice!
quests.funFact: Fun fact: slicing a fruit means cutting it into thin, flat pieces.

quests.instruction: A quick grab of grapes, just enough to fit in one hand, is called a ___. What's the word?
quests.hint: This word describes a small, easy-to-grab amount of fruit.
quests.explanation: Exactly right! A quick grab of grapes, just enough to fit in one hand, is called a handful!
quests.funFact: You usually pick berries by the handful when you visit a farm.

quests.instruction: A small amount of blueberries you can hold in one open palm is called a ___. What's the word?
quests.hint: This word describes an amount of something that fits in just one hand.
quests.explanation: Wonderful! A small amount of blueberries held in one open palm is called a handful!
quests.funFact: A handful of raisins gives you a quick burst of energy.

quests.instruction: A pineapple flown in and sold within days of harvest is considered ___. Which word fits?
quests.hint: This word is the opposite of fruit that's been dried or frozen.
quests.explanation: Terrific! A pineapple flown in and sold within days of harvest is considered fresh, matching this word!
quests.funFact: Did you know? it has the best, most vibrant flavor and the highest vitamins.

quests.instruction: Peaches picked straight from the orchard are gathered into a large ___. Which word matches?
quests.hint: This word names a container carried by a handle, often woven from natural material.
quests.explanation: Yes! Peaches picked straight from the orchard are gathered into a large basket!
quests.funFact: Did you know? baskets are woven containers used for collecting fruit on a farm.

quests.instruction: Apricots left out until they turn wrinkly and chewy have been ___. Which word fits?
quests.hint: This word describes fruit that's shrunk down and lost its plump, juicy shape.
quests.explanation: That's right! Apricots left out until they turn wrinkly and chewy have been dried, matching this word!
quests.funFact: Did you know? dried fruit has been left in the hot sun or an oven to remove water.

quests.instruction: A soft, mushy apple with dark brown spots and a sour smell has gone ___. Which word fits?
quests.hint: This word describes fruit well past ripe, now spoiled and unsafe.
quests.explanation: Great job! A soft, mushy apple with dark brown spots and a sour smell has gone rotten, matching this word!
quests.funFact: Did you know? rotten fruit has gone completely bad and is no longer safe to eat.

quests.instruction: A small scoop of blackberries, just enough to fill one palm, is called a ___. Which word fits?
quests.hint: This word names an amount of fruit sized for a single hand, not a whole bowl.
quests.explanation: You got it! A small scoop of blackberries, just enough to fill one palm, is called a handful!
quests.funFact: Did you know? a handful is the amount of small fruit you can hold in one closed hand.

quests.instruction: A small amount of raspberries scooped up in one palm is called a ___. Which word matches?
quests.hint: This word names a portion sized to fit comfortably in one hand.
quests.explanation: Well done! A small amount of raspberries scooped up in one palm is called a handful!
quests.funFact: Did you know? a handful of blueberries is a perfect, healthy snack.

quests.instruction: A banana covered in mold with a bad smell has gone completely ___. What's the word?
quests.hint: This word describes fruit that's gone bad and is no longer safe to eat.
quests.explanation: Correct! A banana covered in mold with a bad smell has gone completely rotten, matching this word!
quests.funFact: Did you know? fruit rots when bacteria and mold begin to break it down.

quests.instruction: A firm, tart persimmon that puckers your mouth is still ___. Which word fits?
quests.hint: This word describes a fruit that could use several more days before it's ready.
quests.explanation: Super! A firm, tart persimmon that puckers your mouth is still unripe, matching this word!
quests.funFact: Did you know? eating unripe fruit can easily give you a stomach ache.

quests.instruction: One thin, round piece cut from a banana is called a ___. Which word fits?
quests.hint: This word describes just one flat, cut piece, not the whole fruit.
quests.explanation: Nice work! One thin, round piece cut from a banana is called a slice!
quests.funFact: Fun fact: you slice an apple before dipping it in peanut butter.

quests.instruction: A plum that's shrunk into a wrinkly, chewy prune has been ___. Which word matches?
quests.hint: This word describes fruit changed by time or heat until it's small and chewy.
quests.explanation: You found it! A plum shrunk into a wrinkly, chewy prune has been dried, matching this word!
quests.funFact: Did you know? it lasts much longer than fresh fruit without spoiling.

quests.instruction: A peach with a sweet smell and a slight give when pressed is considered perfectly ___. Which word fits?
quests.hint: This word describes fruit at its very best, ready to eat right now.
quests.explanation: Exactly right! A peach with a sweet smell and a slight give is considered perfectly ripe, matching this word!
quests.funFact: Did you know? a ripe tomato is deep red and slightly soft to the touch.

quests.instruction: Grapes still joined to their stem at the market are sold as one whole ___. Which word fits?
quests.hint: This word describes fruit grouped together as a single connected unit.
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Grapes still joined to their stem at the market are sold as one whole bunch!
quests.funFact: Did you know? a bunch is a large group of fruits growing tightly together on one stem.

quests.instruction: Fruit pickers often collect apples in a woven container called a ___. What's the word?
quests.hint: This word names a woven container used to carry lots of fruit at once.
quests.explanation: Terrific! Fruit pickers often collect apples in a woven container called a basket!
quests.funFact: Did you know? a basket protects the soft fruit from getting bruised when you carry it.

quests.instruction: One thin, round piece cut from a fresh orange is called a ___. Which word matches?
quests.hint: This word describes a single flat cut, smaller than the whole fruit.
quests.explanation: Yes! One thin, round piece cut from a fresh orange is called a slice!
quests.funFact: Fun fact: slicing a lemon makes perfect circles to put in a glass of water.

quests.instruction: A big triangular piece of honeydew melon is called a ___. What's the word?
quests.hint: This word describes a triangle-shaped piece, tapering to a point at one end.
quests.explanation: That's right! A big triangular piece of honeydew melon is called a wedge!
quests.funFact: Did you know? watermelon is almost always cut into large, juicy wedges.

quests.instruction: A single flat piece cut from a whole watermelon is called a ___. What's the word?
quests.hint: This word names one single flat piece cut from a larger fruit.
quests.explanation: Great job! A single flat piece cut from a whole watermelon is called a slice!
quests.funFact: Fun fact: a sharp knife is needed to slice cleanly through tough fruit skin.

quests.instruction: Grapes are often carried home from the store in one connected ___. Which word matches?
quests.hint: This word describes many of the same small fruit, grouped as a single unit.
quests.explanation: You got it! Grapes carried home from the store in one connected group are called a bunch!
quests.funFact: Did you know? grapes and bananas naturally grow in heavy bunches.
